# Bryn Mawr College

> A premier women's college in Philadelphia offering rigorous undergraduate and graduate programs with a focus on academics, student experience, and alumni engagement.

Bryn Mawr College is an independent liberal arts institution providing undergraduate education, graduate programs in arts and sciences, social work and social research, and specialized postbaccalaureate premedical preparation. The college emphasizes residential life, student support services, and lifelong alumni community connections.

- [Academics](https://www.brynmawr.edu/academics): Overview of Bryn Mawr's undergraduate and graduate academic programs

- [Graduate School of Social Work and Social Research](https://www.brynmawr.edu/socialwork): Graduate social work programs, degrees, and admissions details
- [Postbaccalaureate Premedical Program](https://www.brynmawr.edu/postbac): Postbaccalaureate premedical program for medical school preparation
